labels.requestedTooltip: If you want the order faster than normal, do not use the Requested Ship Date field.  Instead, scroll down further on this Checkout page, and tick the box 'Do you need BH to review this order'.  In the text box, explain your need, so we can try to make it happen.  If available product is in stock, it usually ships within 5 days. If we need to build or order, we ship as soon as possible, and will send a confirmation once that date is determined.
